details: Published a universal signed and notarized DMG from source commit e7a0fc5e. It adds the OEM-traced KPG-23D TK-350 and KPG-32D TK-359 sessions with BIOS DTR/RTS behavior, the UV-5R/UV-3R aux-first download and UV-3R error reporting, the MD-UV380 short DFU identity read, the TK-863G memory-session retry, and the image-mismatch CSV guidance.
